chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 — No Stimulus (3 points) — Set 1: European overseas expansion
chunks.content: AP European History SAQ 3 (No Stimulus), 3 points, one per part. Set 1 prompts: A [1] describe one significant motivation for European overseas expansion in the period 1450–1648; B [1] describe one significant change in European overseas expansion in the period 1600–1815; C [1] explain one way European overseas expansion affected Europe's economy. 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: vague answers that name a term without characteristics; for C, stating an economic effect without explaining the causal mechanism.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 1) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Described a motivation for expansion, a change in expansion, and explained an economic effect with a causal link. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 1) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 0, C 1). Described a motivation (A) and explained an economic effect (C) but did not describe a valid change in expansion for the later period (B). Illustrates missing the middle 'change' part.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 1) scored 1/3 (A 1, B 0, C 0). Described a motivation for expansion only. Lost B (no valid change) and C (no explained economic effect). Illustrates a response that identifies a motivation but cannot develop a change or a causal economic effect.
